title: BatchEnsemble-style rank-one Mirror experts
hypothesis: A shared expert matrix with low-description Givens expert Views yields useful routed expert multiplicity and beats rank-one BatchEnsemble modulation in MSE-per-byte.

task.router: oracle selects expert by input half; same router for every method

controls: shared expert plus Mirror Givens views

development.selection_metric: mean heldout MSE across all methods/worlds

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=65% independent, and beats BatchEnsemble by >=10% at byte-near cost (within 15%) or strictly lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or BatchEnsemble matches at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: oracle router supplied and charged as metadata
fixed updates are not capacity proof
